_comment: ADR-037 register fragment, change voting-per-body-chair-and-staff (REQ-VPB-001). Voting is per body: a body declares whether its chair has a vote. A council's chair, the mayor, chairs without one; a committee's or a board's chair usually votes. Staff roles (the secretary, the griffier) never vote, whatever the body says; that rule lives in VoterEligibility.

chairHasVote.title: Chair has a vote
chairHasVote.description: Whether the chair of this body casts a vote. Off for a council, whose chair (the mayor) chairs without a vote; on for most committees and boards. Staff such as the secretary never vote.
